name: POS barcode scanner shows front/rear camera switch
description: Open the POS camera barcode scanner and verify the front/rear camera toggle control is always available (not gated on enumerating multiple devices).

planSteps.description: Go directly to /pos/ccef8d1c-72c2-44e8-b61c-6a016656cfd3 (sign in with the configured manager account if redirected to login)
If a staff PIN screen appears, select staff Sara and enter PIN 1234; open shift if needed so the POS selling screen is ready
Click the Camera control on the POS toolbar to open the barcode/QR scanner modal

The scanner dialog is open AND a camera switch control is visible labeled Use front camera OR Use rear camera (or Amharic የፊት ካሜራ / የኋላ ካሜራ). Pass if the switch label is shown even when the camera preview is blocked by the browser.
